type Mapping<T> = { [K in keyof T]: unknown };
type ExplicitArgument<U extends Mapping<U & string>> = U;
type WrappedArgument<U extends Array<Mapping<U & number>>> = U;
type InferredArgument<T> = T extends infer U extends Mapping<U & string> ? U : never;
type DefaultMapping<T, X = T & string> = { [K in keyof X]: unknown };
type DefaultArgument<U extends DefaultMapping<U>> = U;
type Narrow<T> = T & string;
type PlainAlias<U extends [Narrow<U>]> = U;
type Direct<U extends {
  [K in keyof (U & string)]: unknown;
}> = U;
